程序包 org.bukkit.inventory.meta

接口 FireworkMeta

所有超级接口:

public interface FireworkMeta extends ItemMeta
Represents a Material.FIREWORK and its effects. 表示一个 Material.FIREWORK 及其效果。

      Add another effect to this firework. 为该烟花添加另一个效果。

    • addEffects

      void addEffects(FireworkEffect... effects) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Add several effects to this firework. 为该烟花添加多个效果。
      参数:
      effects - The firework effects to add 要添加的烟花效果
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - If effects is null 若 effects 为 null

      Add several firework effects to this firework. 为该烟花添加多个烟花效果。

      effects - An iterable object whose iterator yields the desired 一个可迭代对象，其迭代器产生所需的烟花效果 firework effects

      IllegalArgumentException - If effects is null 若 effects 为 null

    • setPower

      void setPower(int power) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Sets the approximate power of the firework. Each level of power is half a second of flight time. 设置烟花的大致威力。每级威力等于半秒的飞行时间。
      参数:
      power - the power of the firework, from 0-128 烟花的威力，取值 0-128
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - if height<0 or height>128 若 height<0 或 height>128
